plainTranslation: Composite Ascendant in Aquarius: comes across as unique, independent, and a bit unconventional. At its best, this gives the relationship an open, original vibe. The pressure point is reading as detached or hard to pin down.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
